reviewers.summary: The builder accepts arbitrarily large routes and can allocate oversized geometry. It also silently drops route data carrying selectable authority while returning the rest of the scene.

findingList.message: The route has no length bound, so an oversized route can trigger an unbounded TubeGeometry allocation. Reject oversized routes before constructing the geometry.

evidence.codePathTraced: sceneRoute accepts any non-empty points array whose points are inside the floor; the builder then sets TubeGeometry segments to route.length * 12.
evidence.failureScenario: A route with a very large number of valid floor points passes validation and allocates a correspondingly large geometry instead of producing no tube and a route error.

findingList.message: A route with selectable authority is silently omitted while the scene is still returned, contrary to the criterion requiring no group or action.

evidence.codePathTraced: When a route point contains objectId or selectionHandler, sceneRoute returns null. The caller treats null as no route and continues returning the scene root.
evidence.failureScenario: A route point carrying an objectId is rejected as route data, but the builder still returns a group rather than rejecting the scene with no group or action.

reviewers.summary: The scene additions are covered by tests for their basic geometry and several invalid inputs. Route validation still accepts arbitrarily large routes, contrary to the acceptance criterion.

findingList.message: The route validation has no bound on route length. The named `builds shadows route and selection ring` test checks an out-of-floor point, but not the criterion's unbounded-route rejection and exact visible route error.

evidence.codePathTraced: sceneRoute accepts any nonempty route array whose points are finite and inside the floor; the builder then creates TubeGeometry with segments proportional to route.length.
evidence.failureScenario: A caller supplies an extremely large in-bounds route. The builder accepts it and allocates a correspondingly large geometry instead of rejecting the unbounded route with the specified visible route error.

reviewers.summary: An unbounded route reaches geometry construction and can make rendering consume excessive memory or stall.

findingList.message: [A06:2025] The route has no size limit, so an unbounded route can exhaust rendering resources. Reject routes above a fixed maximum before constructing TubeGeometry.

evidence.codePathTraced: Caller-supplied route points pass through sceneRoute without a length bound, then route.length determines TubeGeometry's segment count.
evidence.failureScenario: A caller supplies a very large in-floor route; the builder allocates geometry for 12 segments per point and can exhaust browser memory or freeze rendering instead of returning a route error.
